mapper.sql: c.clnt_id, c.clnt_type_cd, c.clnt_nm, c.biz_reg_no, c.ceo_nm, c.induty_cd, c.chrg_nm, c.telno, c.tax_email_addr, c.bank_cd, c.acct_no_enc, c.dpstr_nm, c.use_yn, c.mod_dttm, COALESCE(b.code_nm, c.bank_cd, '') AS bank_name

(SELECT count(DISTINCT p.proj_id) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.proj_id = a.proj_id JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.dev_id = a.dev_id WHERE AND p.proj_stat_cd = 'ING') AS project_count, (SELECT count(DISTINCT d.dev_id) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.proj_id = a.proj_id JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.dev_id = a.dev_id WHERE ) AS person_count
mapper.select: SELECT , FROM TB_BS_CLNT c LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE b ON b.code_grp_id = 'BANK' AND b.code = c.bank_cd WHERE c.clnt_id = #{clientId}
SELECT , 0::bigint AS project_count, 0::bigint AS person_count FROM TB_BS_CLNT c LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE b ON b.code_grp_id = 'BANK' AND b.code = c.bank_cd WHERE c.clnt_id = #{clientId} FOR UPDATE OF c
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_BS_CLNT, TB_PJ_PROJ, TB_HR_DEV IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT c.clnt_nm FROM TB_BS_CLNT c WHERE c.biz_reg_no = #{businessNumber}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.code_grp_id = #{groupId} AND c.code = #{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BS_CLNT (clnt_id, clnt_type_cd, clnt_nm, biz_reg_no, ceo_nm, induty_cd, chrg_nm, telno, tax_email_addr, bank_cd, acct_no_enc, dpstr_nm, use_yn, reg_user_id, reg_dttm) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{input.clientTypeCode}, #{input.clientName}, #{input.businessNumber}, #{input.representativeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.industryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.contactName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.taxEmail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.bankCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{encryptedAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.accountHolder,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', #{actor}, clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BS_CLNT SET clnt_type_cd=#{input.clientTypeCode}, clnt_nm=#{input.clientName}, ceo_nm=#{input.representativeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, induty_cd=#{input.industryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, chrg_nm=#{input.contactName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, telno=#{input.contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, tax_email_addr=#{input.taxEmail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, bank_cd=#{input.bankCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, acct_no_enc=#{encryptedAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, dpstr_nm=#{input.accountHolder,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, mod_user_id=#{actor}, mod_dttm=GREATEST(clock_timestamp(), COALESCE(mod_dttm,reg_dttm) + INTERVAL '1 microsecond') WHERE clnt_id=#{clientId} AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.cust_clnt_id=#{clientId} AND p.proj_stat_cd='ING')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.blng_clnt_id=#{clientId})

SELECT p.proj_id, p.proj_nm, d.dev_nm, COALESCE(v.clnt_nm,'') AS company_name, COALESCE(j.code_nm,a.job_cd) AS job_name, a.input_end_dt FROM TB_BS_CLNT c JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT v ON v.clnt_id=d.blng_clnt_id LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.code_grp_id='JOB' AND j.code=a.job_cd WHERE c.clnt_id=#{clientId} AND ORDER BY p.proj_nm, d.dev_nm, a.asgn_id
SELECT c.clnt_id FROM TB_BS_CLNT c WHERE c.use_yn='Y' AND c.clnt_type_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') ORDER BY c.clnt_nm, c.clnt_id
